title: LUMI bench result row (JSONL) — schema v1.1
description: v1.1 adds optional provenance fields that were not captured in the 2026-11 campaign. Rows produced by that campaign remain valid: every added field is optional and absent there. Campaign-level values (model, guard version where known, prompt set hash) are in run_manifest.json.

guard_version.description: v1.1: guard build, e.g. 'v3'. Null/absent for the 2026-11 campaign except where run_manifest.json states it.

guard_code_sha256.description: v1.1: sha256 of the guard implementation file used for this row.

model_sha256.description: v1.1: weight-manifest digest of the served model.

model_revision.description: v1.1: upstream revision or snapshot id.

tensor_parallel_size.description: v1.1: TP degree used for the run.
